name: Company Officer B - British Matriarch
description: Native British English, contemporary standard southern English. A distinctly female voice belonging to a woman in her fifties. Excellent studio recording quality. Her speaking voice has a warm, clear, feminine middle register, bright resonance and smooth natural texture. An experienced company officer and reassuring matriarch: capable, attentive, practical and personable. She conveys authority through confident phrasing and clear articulation. Brisk, flowing conversational speech with short natural pauses and lightly animated intonation, approximately 180 words per minute. Her maturity comes through her poise and experience. Genuine warmth for her crew, calm focus during emergencies, and an occasional lightly amused smile. Everyday spoken dialogue with the easy energy of an alert, engaged woman giving instructions.
provenance: Original ElevenLabs Voice Design, feminine British candidate B, approved after v4 emotion tests. No game recordings uploaded or cloned.
